doc.name: Vidé Vita
doc.description: The online shop of Vidé Healthcare Group — genuine goods, with the amount of each active printed on the label.

bearer.description: Reading is open. Ordering and order status need a token from the shop.

skills.name: Find A Supplement
skills.description: Find which Vidé Vita supplement suits a concern, and read its label — the amount of each active per capsule, how to take it, what it costs.

skills.name: Buy Something
skills.description: Turn a decision into a payment link — the shop's own pay page, where PromptPay QR, credit and debit cards and mobile banking are offered.

skills.name: Check An Order
skills.description: Tell a customer where their order has got to, and give them the pay link again if it has not been paid.
